name: dchlseo/eia-data
what_it_holds: Lightweight Python utility wrapping the U.S. EIA API's /petroleum/pri/spt route. Currently implemented: Kerosene-type jet fuel spot price (EPJK) plus crude, diesel, heating oil, gasoline, propane — returns a tidy pandas DataFrame (date, product code/name, price, unit) with CSV export. 8 commits, license unspecified, recent (Sep 2026) activity.
why_useful: Jet fuel spot price is a fast-moving, freely available cost input to airfares; airfare inflation/deflation is a substitution variable for STR demand and a component of BLS CPI airfares already held — this is a lighter-weight, more current alternative puller than scraping EIA's own site directly, useful for a leading-indicator airfare-cost overlay on travel demand.
time_coverage: EIA API history (typically 1990s-present for petroleum spot prices)
size_hint: API wrapper, not a static dump
duplicate_of_holding: Overlaps with FRED airfare/CPI series already held; adds jet-fuel-specific cost input not currently in the FRED panel
themes: wildcard: an airline network planner who knows capacity, schedule, far
